prompts.scene: A fictional portrait magazine cover, vertical 2:3. The subject wears an oatmeal cotton T-shirt and relaxed charcoal trousers, standing in a warm gray portrait studio, torso turned slightly and gaze calmly toward the camera, arms relaxed. Eye-level 65 mm-equivalent waist-up portrait, large soft studio key and subtle fill, true skin texture and natural age. Leave room above the head for the exact masthead "ATELIER NOTES" and lower-left negative space for the exact cover line "SMALL EVERYDAY THINGS". Use a restrained, legible editorial hierarchy. Keep eyes, nose and mouth clearly visible. No additional issue number, barcode, price, real publisher mark or text. This is a fictional design exercise, not a published issue.
